dimension_rule.interpretation: For a finite family of convex sets in R^d, an empty total intersection has a subfamily of at most d + 1 sets whose intersection is already empty.

examples.name: R2 half-plane certificate
examples.verification: If all three inequalities were true, their sum would give 1 <= 0, a contradiction.

examples.name: R3 four-half-space certificate
examples.verification: The four inequalities sum to 1 <= 0. Omitting any one of the four leaves a feasible subsystem.

algorithmic_certificate_check: List the active sets or inequalities named by the candidate certificate.
Confirm the certificate subfamily has size at most d + 1.
Verify directly that the subfamily intersection is empty or that the multiplier sum contradicts feasibility.
Keep the remaining constraints out of the proof; Helly says they are not needed for the emptiness certificate.
